properties.description: **Enterprise** — Zero-trust and regulatory alignment for VirtualEnclaves: controls that require infrastructure investment or map directly to compliance frameworks. This tier delivers private endpoints and private link removing the public attack surface. Together these policies protect against lateral movement, sovereign-data exfiltration, and audit gaps in regulated workloads. Maps to NIS2 Articles 21–23, ISO 27001 A.13.1.3 (network segregation) and A.18 (compliance), NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust).

metadata.policyName: Configure Storage Accounts to restrict network access through network ACL bypass configuration only.
Storage Accounts should restrict network access through network ACL bypass configuration only.
